_doc: 划船人的三封信与石头小屋（PaddlerStory 读取）。前一位旅人把石头小屋三环锁的三个图案分别写进三封信：木屋书架顶上的旧书（cabin，木屋局部坐标见 CabinLife）、码头尽头的旧木盒（dock）、湖心小岛营火边的铁盒（islet）；后两处的位置在 world_layout.json → letters。顺序随意，读过的 id 记在 WorldState.flags.letters；三封都读过之后，在小屋门前按 E 就能开锁（flags.cottage_unlocked）。symbol 是锁上的图案，对应湖畔夜空的星座。chart 是小屋桌上那张没画完的星图。文字都有中英两份。

letters.title: 夹在旧书里的信
letters.title_en: A Letter in an Old Book
letters.text:
给下一个住进木屋的人：

炉子先放细柴，再放松果，火就旺了。下雨时屋顶会响，那是雨在说话，不是漏了。

我在南边草地上盖了一间石头小屋。门上的锁有三个转环，我把三个图案分别写进三封信，留在这片湖我最舍不得的地方：这本书里一封，码头尽头的旧木盒里一封，湖心小岛的营火边还有一封。

第一个环，转到独木舟。
letters.text_en:
To whoever lives in the cabin next:

Lay thin sticks in the stove first, then pinecones, and the fire will take. When it rains the roof sings. That is the rain talking, not a leak.

I built a stone cottage on the meadow to the south. Its lock has three rings, and I wrote one picture into each of three letters, left in the places on this lake I could least bear to leave: one in this book, one in the old box at the end of the dock, one by the campfire on the islet.

The first ring turns to the canoe.

letters.title: 旧木盒里的信
letters.title_en: A Letter in the Old Box
letters.text:
我常坐在这里，等太阳落到湖对岸。它每天都落在同一个地方，像那边有人点了一盏灯，在等谁过去。

后来我真的过去了。山洞里那位老朋友守着火，走不开，我就替它去看了看那些门后面的地方。它们都停在黄昏里，每一处都有一盏熄了很久的灯。

你要是也去了，记得把灯点亮再回来。

第二个环，转到狐狸。
letters.text_en:
I used to sit here and wait for the sun to set across the lake. It sets in the same place every day, as if someone over there had lit a lamp and was waiting for someone to come.

In the end I went. Our old friend in the cave keeps the fire and cannot leave it, so I went to look at the places behind the gates for it. They have all stopped at dusk, and each has a lamp that went out long ago.

If you go too, light the lamp before you come home.

The second ring turns to the fox.

letters.title: 营火边的信
letters.text:
夜里躺在这里，能看见天上的独木舟、狐狸和灯塔。那时候湖边只有我一个人，我就把星星连起来，给它们起了名字。

我还画了一张星图，没画完，留在小屋的桌上。要是你在别的世界看见新的星星，替我补上。

我的第一条船沉在一口很深的水里，旁边有一圈旧石环。我没去捞它，它在那里替我记着路。

第三个环，转到灯塔。
letters.text_en:
Lying here at night you can see the Canoe, the Fox and the Lighthouse in the sky. Back then I was the only one by the lake, so I joined up the stars and gave them names.

I drew a star chart too. It is not finished; it is on the table in the cottage. If you see new stars in another world, add them for me.

My first boat sank in very deep water, beside an old ring of stone. I never raised it. It keeps the way for me there.

The third ring turns to the lighthouse.

lock.unlock: 你把三个转环转到独木舟、狐狸、灯塔。咔哒一声，锁开了。
lock.unlock_en: You turn the three rings to the canoe, the fox and the lighthouse. With a click, the lock opens.

chart.title: 没画完的星图
chart.text: 墨点连成湖畔夜空的五个星座。旁边一行小字：「还差三个。云上的、沙里的、海底的。」纸的右边空着，留了三块位置。
chart.text_en: Ink dots join up the five constellations of the lake sky. A line of small writing beside them: "Three still missing. One above the clouds, one in the sand, one under the sea." The right side of the sheet is empty, with room left for three more.
